[quote=sikirsk;61502952][b]Former-Sovereignty[/b]

Once Ostarev's announcement was picked up by Sikirskian state monitoring agencies... It didn't take long for it to reach the Marshal-President...

[i]Soon afterwards, a Federation-wide announcement was made across Sikirsk and the Bolerevan nations. 
[/i]
"Goodday, fellow comrades, today we stand before an greater evil that has landed upon our continent. The United States of Lockheed's open deployment of even more large-scale air assets upon the sovereign nation of Ostarev, is a clear violation of Shamat's independence and freedom. We must not allow such deployments to happen, especially in our own former territories. Sikirsk and its territorial partners will not hesitate to take action if these assets are not removed within the next couple weeks."

[b]"Glory to the Federation." [/b]

[i]Afterwards, a official diplomatic notice demanding the same thing was sent to Ostarev by the SMFD.[/i][/quote]

[i]Your usage of the word sovereignty perplexes me. Is Ostarev not a sovereign nation that can decide whom it wishes to partner with, and whom it does not? You, yourself call Ostarev a sovereign nation. You have no control over the assets which enter or leave our territory, to claim such is a gross violation of our sovereignty. We do not serve at your pleasure, and we are not responsible for seeing that your will is done. Maybe if you wish for things to be different, you could step up to negotiate peace in our region. But I doubt that happens; therefor, the necessity for defense still exists and continues to looms over our heads. 

The assets will go nowhere and your empty threats mean nothing. Ostarev remains a nation which has never fought an offensive war, there is no threat to you from us unless you provoke us to action. Ostarev will continue to practice its right to self determination. If you ever become so bold as to attempt to strike Ostarev, you will be met with hellfire and ruthlessness.

We extend our hand, just as you have, for discussions of peace. But seeing as your opening statement threatened action against our people, I doubt your true intentions were to seek peace to begin with.[/i]
